seo.title: Dorit Gov Ari | Financial planner & insurance agent
seo.description: Financial planner and insurance agent with 30 years' experience. Pension, provident and study-fund planning, life and health insurance, and claims support — personal, transparent and in plain language. A free management-fee calculator.
hero.byline: Dorit Gov Ari · Financial planner & insurance agent
hero.claimMeeting: An introductory meeting at no cost
hero.lead: Financial and insurance planning that starts from the full picture — pension, provident and study funds, tax and the fixation of pension rights, and the management fees taken from your savings over the years.
arch.title: Pension and insurance planning, without the small print
carriers.title: Working with Israel's leading pension and insurance companies
carriers.disclosure: I work with a range of insurance and pension companies to match a solution to your needs. As an insurance agent, I have ties to institutional bodies — as set out in the disclosure.
about.imgPen: A quill pen on a stone surface
about.family: I'm Dorit Gov Ari, married to Niv and mother of Sagi, Eden and Yarin.
about.credentials: A veteran of finance and insurance, I hold an agent's licence and an academic degree in behavioural sciences, management and economics.
about.career: For many years I worked as an independent financial and insurance planner, then 12 years at Mizrahi Tefahot Bank as a pension adviser, and a long period as a pension and tax planner at Harel's centre for advanced financial planning. In recent years I have worked as a senior financial planner specialising in the various aspects of tax, together with Four Seasons — one of the largest financial-planning firms in the country.
about.insight: Over the years I came to understand a few things about pensions: the confusion, the helplessness in front of provident funds, study funds and the various pension products, and a lack of knowledge lead people into significant mistakes — precisely with their largest and most important money. Clients need solutions tailored to their own needs and their partner's.
about.unique: What sets me apart as a professional: a great deal of expertise and experience, genuine care and honesty towards clients, plain-language explanations anyone can follow in this complex field — and above all humanity, warmth and always a smile.
services.title: The five pillars of planning
services.intro: Most of your money is already deposited somewhere — pension, provident fund, study fund. Here we look at what you have, what it costs, and what it is meant to do for you.
services.p1.title: Pension, provident & study funds
services.p1.desc: Reviewing your existing products, investment tracks and transfers — and matching them to your stage of life and the horizon over which the money is meant to work.
services.p2.title: Tax & fixation of rights
services.p2.desc: Tax planning ahead of retirement, fixation of rights, Amendment 190, and making full use of the tax benefits on your deposits.
services.p3.title: Management fees & costs
services.p3.desc: Checking the costs charged over your years of saving, and dealing with the institutional bodies on your behalf.
services.p4.title: Life & health insurance
services.p4.desc: Cover for the family, loss of working capacity, health and mortgage cover — matched to the people who actually depend on you.
services.p5.title: Claims advocacy
services.p5.desc: Close support when it matters most — handling the claim with the company on your behalf, from the first report to the decision.

proof.basis: An estimate based on assumptions about returns and management fees
proof.c1.title: From rejection to full approval in 11 days
proof.c1.body: A family whose life-insurance claim was initially refused. I ran the process with the company, completed the documentation and secured the full cover — without the family having to make a single phone call.
proof.c2.title: A plan that doubled the expected retirement income
proof.c2.body: A 47-year-old self-employed client with a scattered portfolio. I consolidated products, built a tailored track and adjusted the exposure — according to the projection, a monthly retirement income twice that of the original portfolio.
proof.c3.title: A 38% saving on the premium
proof.c3.body: A couple with a new mortgage had been given a standard quote. I checked the cover against their real risk profile, removed duplications and reduced the cost significantly.
proof.c4.title: Surgery cover approved within 48 hours
proof.c4.body: A client who needed urgent surgery had been refused twice. I intervened directly with the approvals department, and the cover was approved before the operation.
proof.c5.title: Cover for business partners
proof.c5.body: Partners in a mid-sized business with no partnership agreement. I put together a set of covers designed to support the continuity of the business and the families in case of loss of working capacity or death.
proof.c6.title: An estimated ₪420,000 saved in management fees
proof.c6.body: A 39-year-old employee paying into four different products with high management fees. I consolidated them into two focused tracks, negotiated with the institutional bodies and lowered the fees — the cumulative saving by retirement is estimated at ₪420,000.
proof.c7.title: Going self-employed with a three-year safety cushion
proof.c7.body: A couple in their 40s wanted to become self-employed but feared the uncertainty. I built a multi-year financial plan: an emergency fund, a risk map and a staged investment track. Three years later they went independent with a full safety cushion.
